last_result.headline: Q11 closed: every path-ranker arm LOSES to simply using the PF mean path. On 40 held-out wells prior(14) -0.3985, TWH1(10) -0.5604, both(24) -0.1897 vs the PF mean default; best arm helps 40% of wells with 3-well P(gain>0) 0.2696. The ORACLE best-of-96 is 7.1579 and DOES beat deployed 8.8626, so the information exists in the path set, but it is truth-selected. Mechanism: the PF mean IS the averaging that rule #1 says transfers; a ranker replaces it with a single bet (downside -11.15 vs upside +3.83), which is why a better score did not rescue it. Closes the PF-path line second shape. An 8-well smoke showed +73.5% headroom conversion that inverted to -12.8% at 40 wells.
